ui_bugs.issue: Application with status='confirmed' (no final_outcome) is not classified as a joined board member. joined filter only matches final_outcome==='Joined Board' or status==='Selected'. This blocks the Board Member Portfolio material card, Engagement Guide card, and PortfolioActions row (portfolio-view-online-*, portfolio-pdf-*, portfolio-prepare-email-*) from rendering for confirmed members.

integration_issues.issue: Seed data (status='confirmed') does not match frontend joined-filter. Either the backend approve/confirm flow needs to set status='Selected' (or final_outcome='Joined Board') when a member is formally confirmed in Step 5, or the frontend filter must be extended to include 'confirmed'.

critical_code_review_comments: ResultsPage.jsx:126 — joined filter hard-codes two exact match values (final_outcome==='Joined Board' || status==='Selected') and misses the 'confirmed' status which is what the portfolio approve/seed flow appears to write. Either the terminology needs unification across backend (workspace_routes.py) and frontend (ResultsPage.jsx), or a shared constant/enum should encode the set of joined-board statuses.

CoursePages.jsx:219 — placeholderTitle override is scoped by module.number===1 alone; happens to be safe because reactivation uses a different VideoBlock via ReactivationCoursePages.jsx, but a productSlug guard (productSlug==='self-guided' && module.number===1 && meta.key==='recruitment_self_guided') would make the intent explicit and prevent a future basic-recruitment-M1 or accidental cross-course reuse from picking up the wrong copy.

rca of the issue: The Board Member Portfolio UI hides behind BoardMemberResultCard which is only rendered for applications that pass the joined filter: `list.filter(a => a.final_outcome === 'Joined Board' || a.status === 'Selected')` in /app/frontend/src/member/workspace/ResultsPage.jsx:126. The iter37 seed data set opportunity_applications.status='confirmed' (matching the observed backend convention when a portfolio is approved and shared). Because 'confirmed' is not in the joined filter, the application is routed to `inProgress` and only appears as a plain text line under 'Still In Progress' — no MaterialCard, no PortfolioActions row (view/pdf/prepare-email), no board_member_engagement_guide card. Public /portfolio/{share_token} and the underlying backend endpoints all function correctly (verified rendering member name, org, issuer). Mitigation: extend joined filter to include 'confirmed' OR align backend to write status='Selected' + final_outcome='Joined Board' upon Step 5 confirmation.
